lastText: The Work CollapsesFull ExposureNew Ending Found · 1 / 16MOB STORMS CASTLE’S WEST TOWERThere is no bribe left to pay and no story left to tell. The magistrate arrives with the mob a half-step behind him, torches already lit. Whatever Victor Frankenstein built in that room, the town decides collectively and immediately that it should never have existed, and neither, it turns out, should he.Your RecordTrackThe Galvanic AutomatonChoices Made13DifficultyThe DebtorPurse Left30 ThalerVoltage+6Biomass-3Secrecy-10What You CarriedYou took the body from the scaffold.Clerk Waldman talked.The town saw something on the battlements.The harness was riveted wrong.The town saw the blue light on the spires.You wrote the Rector a dull letter about Saint Elmo’s fire.In the NovelIn the novel Victor does tell a Geneva magistrate the whole story.
